body.p: Sands & McDougall's Melbourne and suburban directory, 1890. 1,480 pages.
State Library Victoria has digitised this directory, and you can read it online.
The listings here come from the 1890 directory's Carlton section, pp. 119–145.
The project covers the area south of Grattan Street, west of Swanston Street, east of Elizabeth Street and north of Victoria Street, and only the listings inside it are kept here.
